newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian RTS breaks turnover, index records.
newsitem.headline: Russian RTS breaks turnover, index records.

text.p: The Russian Trading System index of 22 leading shares closed at a record 433.12 on Wednesday, up 5.04 percent on Tuesday's record closing 412.32, the NAUFOR brokers association said.
Market turnover was a record $94.3 million, breaking the previous record set last Friday of $77.3 million.
But traders said profit taking chipped into gains in afternoon trading and saw downward pressure through the end of the week.

"When the market has gained so much, it is time to cut long positions," said Sergei Sheikov, head of corporate securities at Austria's Raiffeisen bank. "I think everyone's been waiting for this correction -- it's normal profit taking."

Oil company LUKoil LKOH.RTS rose to $19.950 at 1506 GMT from Tuesday's closing $18.71 but off a daily high of around $21.650 while regional utility Mosenergo MSNG.RTS rose to to $1.494 from $1.475 and also off a daily $1.535 high.
NAUFOR did not publish official closing prices due to technical difficulties.
Traders said the correction would last at least 2-3 days, although it could drag on for longer in a worst-case scenario, given the significant rise in past days on many positions.
"The correction could be fairly extended," said senior Trinfiko trader Grigory Pinsky. "Russian operators have remembered that the market can go not only up but down -- they are a little bit scared."

Sheikov said investor attention might now turn to the second and third tier stocks, although Alfa Capital trader Dmitry Lobanov said the less liquid shares would not necessarily see such global growth.
"On that market movement in different directions has started and not everything is growing by any means," Lobanov said.
Among the gainers on Wednesday, he said telecoms Moscow region Electrosvyaz rose to $750/$790 for bid/offer rates from $720/$750 on Tuesday. Rostovelektrosvyaz rose to $3.10/$3.25 from $2.90/$3.07.
